description:
Affiliate Marketing Program Overview

Brand Introduction:
We are a halal-friendly wellness brand dedicated to providing high-quality, ethical products designed specifically for the Muslim community. Our mission is to offer effective health solutions that align with Islamic values and promote a lifestyle of health, wellness, and conscious consumption. We aim to create an impact by giving Muslims the opportunity to support brands that are ethically responsible while achieving their health and wellness goals.

Product Description:
Our flagship product is a vegan, halal-friendly digestive enzyme supplement formulated to support overall digestive health, reduce bloating, and enhance nutrient absorption. The product is made with carefully selected plant-based ingredients such as Makzyme-Pro™, Bromelain, Papain, and various beneficial probiotics (Lactobacillus acidophilus, Lactobacillus plantarum, etc.), which have been tested for their effectiveness and safety. The product is free from haram ingredients, non-GMO, gluten-free, and easy to use with vegetarian capsules, designed for the modern Muslim seeking digestive support in a natural, halal way.

Unique Selling Point:

  • Halal & Vegan-Friendly: Our product is formulated with 100% plant-based ingredients and designed with Muslims in mind, making it the perfect choice for a halal lifestyle.
  • Digestive Health Focus: With a blend of digestive enzymes and probiotics, this product helps to alleviate bloating, support gut health, and improve digestion.
  • Ethically Produced: We are committed to offering products that are not only beneficial but also ethically sourced, with a focus on transparency and sustainable practices.
  • Proven Ingredients: Each ingredient has been carefully selected based on its effectiveness for digestive health and overall wellness.

Payment Terms:

  • We offer a performance-based commission system to ensure that affiliates are rewarded fairly for their efforts.
  • Commission Breakdown:
    • 20% per sale (up to $750 in total sales per month)
    • 25% per sale (sales between $750 - $1,800 per month)
    • 30% per sale (sales above $1,800 per month)
    • $7.20+ per subscription per month (recurring commission from subscription-based customers)
  • Affiliates are paid monthly via PayPal or direct bank transfer, depending on preference.

Other Information:

  • No upfront costs: There’s no fee to join our affiliate program, and affiliates can start earning as soon as they sign up.
  • Marketing Support: Affiliates will have access to a range of marketing materials, including banners, product images, and social media templates to help promote the product effectively.
  • Tracking & Analytics: Our affiliate dashboard provides real-time tracking of sales and commissions so you can easily monitor your performance and optimize your marketing strategies.
  • Long-Term Partnership: We are looking to build strong, lasting relationships with our affiliates. As a partner, you will have the opportunity to promote new products, participate in exclusive offers, and be part of a community that aims to make a real impact in the wellness space.

We are excited to have you on board and help you create a sustainable income stream while promoting a product that truly aligns with your values!
